definition: Two admissible routes give identical outputs on the declared comparison surface.
boundary: Commutation at one quotient need not hold at a finer quotient.

definition: Divergent admissible reductions rejoin at an equivalent formed result.
certificate: joinability witness and package equivalence audit
boundary: Local confluence may require termination for global confluence.

definition: Routes differ internally but are audit-equivalent at the declared target.
boundary: Internal route memory may still matter for future probes.

definition: A closed route has nonzero comparison residue or memory defect.
certificate: common typed carrier, route maps, and residue
boundary: Holonomy is P3-side evidence, not a P6 arrow.

definition: Apparent order/arrow evidence is generated by scheduling or hidden protocol while the autonomous system has zero drive.
certificate: lifted protocol model and arrow null
boundary: Does not rule out genuinely driven dynamics.

definition: A cycle carries a separately certified nonzero drive/current/entropy-production quantity.
certificate: P6 drive certificate in addition to route structure
boundary: Directionality still remains interface- and protocol-relative.

definition: Routes cannot be compared or joined because typing, gluing, source, budget, or package gates fail.
boundary: Failure of one route class does not imply universal noninteraction.
